description: This file defines the CompanyStructureDao class which manages data access for Subunit entities in the company structure, including retrieving, saving, adding, deleting subunits, setting organization name, and fetching subunit tree structure.

classes.name: CompanyStructureDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing company structure subunits, including CRUD operations and hierarchical queries.

methods.name: getSubunitById
methods.description: Fetches a Subunit entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveSubunit
methods.description: Persists a Subunit entity to the database.

methods.name: addSubunit
methods.description: Adds a subunit as a child to a parent subunit and clears the entity manager.

methods.name: deleteSubunit
methods.description: Deletes a subunit from the company structure.

methods.name: setOrganizationName
methods.description: Sets the organization name at the top level (level 0) for all subunits.

methods.name: getSubunitTree
methods.description: Returns the hierarchical tree of subunits up to an optional depth.

methods.name: getMaxLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum depth level in the subunit hierarchy.
